fields.summary_ko.0: Micron Technology (MU) lost nearly half its market cap over five months but rose 120% YTD, with Wall Street price targets reflecting 160% upside.
fields.summary_ko.1: Bull case targets $1,800–$2,200 by end-2029 (3.2x), base case $1,100–$1,400 (2x earnings), bear case $400–$600, with Chinese competitor CXMT's HBM technology progress as key variable.
